sourceSections.title: Warm-up: Notice and Wonder: Graph (10 minutes)
sourceSections.review: Original unlabeled/unspecified scale graph; non-integer person when 1 response per unit, teacher discussion

sourceSections.title: Activity 1: Draw a Scaled Bar Graph (20 minutes)
sourceSections.review: Actual Lesson 6 category counts; intervals, maximum/minimum, title, labels

sourceSections.title: Activity 2: Ask and Answer Questions (20 minutes)
sourceSections.review: Author more/fewer and A-or-B-versus-C questions, exchange graphs with new partner

sourceSections.title: Lesson Synthesis
sourceSections.review: Benefits of consistent scale other than one when sampling a large school population

sourceSections.title: Cool-down: Graph Question (5 minutes)
sourceSections.review: Publisher-only gated material not read, copied, or passed off as first-party equivalent

humanRubric: Authentic recorded survey data from previous lesson, without invented figures
Consistent labeled graph scale and heights matching authentic counts
Title and both axis labels; individual category names
Mathematically valid one-step how-many-more/fewer and two-step combined-category comparisons
